title: Unit Event — Cast a Spell on You — Episode5 What I Want to Make

meta.Episode: Episode5 — What I Want to Make
meta.Event Outline: Having held their real-life event, Shizuku and the others feel that their bond with their fans has grown even stronger. While exploring ideas with their fans, one of them suggests making MORE MORE JUMP! stage outfits as their next endeavor!

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, this doesn't seem right either...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I've drawn a few already since coming home, but none of these seem to fit the bill...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's no right answer, so I say take as many liberties as you like when coming up with a design.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: By doing so, I'm sure you'll be able to come up with the outfit you really want to design.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (What sort of outfit do I want to design?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The others already seemed to know the answer to that question.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So, what's the outfit I'm looking for? How am I going to express myself...?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Unlike the others, I'm not sure I have anything to offer...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Even when I was the lead girl for Cheerful * Days, my head was full of just trying to maintain the image they asked me to portray.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Now, my fans are willing to see me for who I really am.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I'm neither a top-flight idol, like Haruka, nor an idol who can cheer everybody up, like Airi.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Or someone with Minori's determination...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This is bad. I can't think of anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I really want to hear what Airi thinks, but it'd be rude to call her this late...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku and the others might still be awake.
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO!
We want to help you with the next show.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Sure, but what's gotten into you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The way Minori and the girls have been putting on their own events and designing their own stage outfits got us thinking!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We don't want to “just perform” in events, we want to build them from the ground up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've come up with set lists and helped set other things up before, but never from the very start. That's why we want to learn more.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
Alright, let's work on the next event together!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What should we do first?
Shows are fun and all, but I wanna try doing a meet-and-greet like Minori and the girls♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Oh, what if we wore outfits that we don't usually wear?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, great idea!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sounds like you have a fun show in store for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But before we do that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hi, Shizuku!
Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I didn't mean to interrupt your discussion. It sounded very important...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, that's okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What's wrong, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. And you're having trouble coming up with ideas for a stage outfit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The other girls seem to know exactly how to express themselves, but I just don't know how to do that it seems.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
For the sake of our fans...
For the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!
I want to come up with a good design...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Let me ask you this, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In your mind, what qualifies as a “good design”?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Something that lets everyone from MORE MORE JUMP! really shine on stage...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And ideally, something that can spread hope to all of our fans since they've been a massive source of support for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wonderful. It sounds like you have a nice design in mind!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But the problem is that I'm having trouble putting my design together onto a sheet of paper.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, okay...
Yeah, that isn't exactly easy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Isn't there anything you can use as reference...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know.
Shizuku, come with me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: With you? Where?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. There's something I want to show you♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, you mean there?
I wanna go too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure, let's go together!
We'll talk later, okay, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Of course. Have fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh wow...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
This is incredible.
Are these all stage outfits and costumes?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes! Enough for us, Luka and MEIKO. Oh, Len and KAITO's outfits are here too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just thinking about wearing one of these for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Despite there being so many idol outfits, putting one on always feels like a transformation process.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A transformation process?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Like I'm turning into a different me...
Someone who sparkles and is capable of doing anything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A different me...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, Shizuku, all of these outfits and costumes are made of “thoughts and feelings”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right♪
Because we want everyone to smile. Because we want to inspire hope in them. And because we want to shine...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: These are a representation of everyone's thoughts and feelings!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I'm sure that you'll come up with a wonderful design once you know what kind of message you want your outfit to convey♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What I want to convey with my outfit...?
